vb_textbox.text: All colors are linked. If you get a good number of mushrooms by selecting a color (Example purple), keep choosing the color tones that are the same or similar to that one (like pink, red). When the numbers of mushrooms you get decreases then switch to the other set of colors (green, brown).For best results try to keep a finger on each key that you will be instructed to use, as you only have min time to make your selection.
